title: log-unknown-subscription-method
request: Add a debug log when event_from_wire gets an unknown method so we can see unexpected subscription messages. Include the method name in the log.
reference_diff:
--- a/src/mcp/shared/subscriptions.py
+++ b/src/mcp/shared/subscriptions.py
@@ -19,6 +19,8 @@
     SubscriptionFilter,
     ToolListChangedNotification,
 )
+import logging
+log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
 
 __all__ = [
     "LISTEN_STREAM_METHODS",
@@ -95,6 +97,8 @@
         uri = (params or {}).get("uri")
         if isinstance(uri, str):
             return ResourceUpdated(uri=uri)
+    # Log unknown methods for debugging
+    log.debug("event_from_wire received unknown method %s", method)
     return None
test_diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_subscription_logging.py
@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+import logging
+import pytest
+from mcp.shared.subscriptions import event_from_wire
+
+def test_event_from_wire_logs_unknown_method(caplog):
+    # Ensure debug messages are captured
+    caplog.set_level(logging.DEBUG)
+    unknown_method = "notifications/unknown/event"
+    result = event_from_wire(unknown_method, None)
+    assert result is None
+    # Verify that a debug log was emitted with the method name
+    debug_messages = [rec.message for rec in caplog.records if rec.levelno == logging.DEBUG]
+    assert any(unknown_method in msg for msg in debug_messages), "Expected debug log for unknown method"
